description: This file defines a class for handling bank account information with IBAN validation and formatting, including methods for creating, updating, and validating IBANs, as well as extracting bank account numbers from IBANs for specific countries.

classes.name: res_partner_bank
classes.description: A class extending osv.osv to manage partner bank accounts with IBAN support, including validation and extraction methods.

methods.name: _format_iban
methods.description: Formats an IBAN string by removing non-alphanumeric characters and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Overrides the create method to format the IBAN before creating a record.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides the write method to format the IBAN before updating a record.

methods.name: check_iban
methods.description: Validates the IBAN number using checksum algorithm.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Returns display names for bank records, prioritizing IBAN if in 'iban' state.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Overrides search to include IBAN in search criteria.

methods.name: get_bban_from_iban
methods.description: Extracts bank account number from IBAN based on country-specific rules.
